task.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Make ONE exquisite integrated Fool pathway + rank 5 insignia, continuing a coherent family of ornate mask-and-curtain numerals. Reference 1 supplies the Fool theatrical half-mask and smoky-purple curtain identity; reference 2 supplies the exact readable Arabic numeral 5. Agentic sculptural redesign: fuse their structure and negative spaces into ONE complete object, never a numeral pasted over a separate crest. A folded curtain lintel forms the flat top of 5, a short left stem joins the middle shoulder, and the mask profile grows into the curved lower bowl. The open upper-right notch and lower-left opening must stay clear. The ONLY readable digit is 5, unmistakable small. Antique pale gold, mist silver, ivory carved mask, smoky violet enamel drapery; museum jewelry-level microchasing, sculptural relief, satin recesses and polished bevels. Rich but coherent detail, no surrounding badge, no words, no other digit. FRONT ORTHOGRAPHIC square image; full object centered with generous 8% clear margins, no cropped tips. Genuinely transparent background including internal openings; no white backdrop or checkerboard pixels, no external cast shadow. Preserve the mask's identity and the numeral's readability together.
